description:
Activate Arms Race by paying {1}{R}, putting Boommobile from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boommobile enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} or {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Boommobile from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
